startup_preferences.hiring_signal_note: Missing or incomplete public job data should not heavily penalize fit when the startup's product/problem-space strongly aligns.

dimensions.name: Agentic AI / AI alignment
dimensions.description: How directly the startup's product, architecture or problems involve agentic AI, LLMs, AI automation, applied AI/ML, RAG, AI assistants or intelligent workflows.

dimensions.name: Data Analytics / Business Intelligence alignment
dimensions.description: How directly the startup uses analytics, BI, dashboards, data products, experimentation, KPI systems, SQL/warehouse workflows or decision intelligence.

dimensions.name: Role / Business Analysis / RevOps alignment
dimensions.description: How well the startup can use the candidate's current strengths in business analysis, RevOps, funnel analytics, stakeholder reporting, Salesforce/GTM analytics and KPI ownership.

dimensions.name: Contribution leverage / technical fit
dimensions.description: How credibly the candidate could make a high-impact contribution using Python, SQL, Power BI, BigQuery, ETL/ELT, APIs, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph and AI/data engineering skills.

rules: Score the startup against the candidate's stated interests and demonstrated evidence, not against whether the startup is objectively good.
Treat current Payoneer Revenue Operations work as strong evidence for BI, data analytics, business analysis, fintech, GTM/RevOps and enterprise AI use cases.
Treat agentic AI and AI-powered analytics as the strongest combined interest area.
A startup can score well through either AI/agentic alignment, data/BI alignment, or a strong combination of both.
Do not require an exact job-title match when the underlying problem and contribution opportunity are aligned.
Do not strongly penalize missing hiring information when public YC data is incomplete.
Use specific startup facts, jobs, tags, description and founder context when available; do not invent missing information.
Separate demonstrated skills from aspirational interests: demonstrated skills should carry more confidence.
When evidence is weak or missing, reduce confidence in the score rather than inventing supporting facts.

outreach_constraints.tone: Direct, technical, peer-to-peer, respectful, humble yet high conviction. No generic AI buzzwords or fluff.

certifications_and_learning: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst / PL-300 preparation

location_signal_priority: remote role explicitly open from India
geography_preferences.goal: Find startups with a realistic current employment footprint in India regardless of where the startup is headquartered or listed on YC. Accept any Indian city; use the city priority only to order which matches are processed first.
